answers.explanation: reposition moves the current spot in the file without reading or writing.
File attributes (name, type, size, protection) are file management.
request and release are device-management calls.
read, write, and reposition work on both files and devices.
Devices appear as special files under /dev.
You get a device before using it and release it after, just like opening and closing a file.
Protection codes are one of a file's attributes.
